page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.4xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. The instance provides 16 dedicated virtual CPUs backed by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. With 128.0 GB of system memory, it establishes a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio, equating to 8.0 GB of RAM per allocated virtual core.

The hardware configuration does not feature integrated local storage, meaning primary and secondary disk operations require remote block storage volumes. In terms of external connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps. No graphical processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this server configuration.

From a resource-efficiency perspective, the high RAM density relative to compute allocation prevents over-provisioning CPU cores merely to satisfy memory requirements. This architecture is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, including in-memory databases, large-scale Redis or Memcached caching tiers, distributed data processing, and enterprise application deployments requiring substantial operational memory.
